{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species across the entire dataset (ignoring island, as the question is descriptive)
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values('flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['species']

# Print the full table for evidence
mean_flipper_by_species, highest_species"}
